annotations.title: これから変わる日本の決まり（改正カレンダー・日付順）

description: Upcoming (and in-progress) changes to Japanese business rules in date order — consumption tax (the proposed 1% food rate, still a bill), invoice transitional credit steps (80→70→50→30→0%), the 2割/3割 special rules, income tax basic deduction, withholding tables, the defense special income tax, minimum wage, employment insurance rates, the child-support levy, the working-pension threshold and the departure tax. Each item has effective dates, a status (in_force / enacted / bill / planned) computed against today, a one-line summary in Japanese, the official source URL and the date Cyclix Agents checked it, and the Tax Compass tool that calculates it if there is one. Filter by as_of (list items that start on or after it, or are still in effect on it — a change with no end date stays in effect), until, areas and statuses. Only items whose numbers were checked against the official source are listed; it is not a complete list of all law changes.

areas.description: 分野で絞る（省くと全部）

as_of.description: この日以後に始まる変更と、この日に当てはまっている変更（終わりの日が無い物を含む）を出す YYYY-MM-DD。省くと今日（日本時間）

statuses.description: 状態で絞る（省くと全部）。bill は国会で未成立

until.description: この日までに始まる変更だけ YYYY-MM-DD（省くと全部）
